questions.reference_answer: The ServiceExperience attribute is defined as a supported/used feature in: ts_29_508_5.8 is the Nsmf_EventExposure API feature table but does not list ServiceExperience among its features; ts_29_517_5.8 (Naf_EventExposure API, feature 1, indicating support for the event related to service experience); ts_29_520_5.1.8 (Nnwdaf_EventsSubscription API, feature 1, same description) and ts_29_520_5.2.8 (Nnwdaf_AnalyticsInfo API, feature 4, same description); ts_29_522_5.6.4 (AnalyticsExposure API, used as feature name in that table); and ts_29_591_5.1.8 (Nnef_EventExposure API, feature 1, indicating support for the "SVC_EXPERIENCE" event).

questions.question: Which clauses list the 'Announcement period' information element in group call / group communication announcement information flows for MCPTT, MCVideo and IOPS?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Announcement period' IE, indicating the period of the group call/communication announcement, is listed in ts_23_180_10.5.1.2.1 (IOPS group call announcement, MCPTT), ts_23_281_7.1.3.2.1 (Group communication announcement, MCVideo), and ts_23_379_10.6.3.2.1 (Group call announcement, MCPTT).

questions.question: Where is the 'Authorization result' information element defined in the ad hoc group call / data session request return information flows?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Authorization result' IE is defined in ts_23_281_7.19.2.2 (Ad hoc group call request return, MCVideo server-client), ts_23_282_7.17.2.2 (Ad hoc group data session request return, MCData server-client), ts_23_379_10.6.2.2.48 (Preconfigured regroup request return, MCPTT server-client), and ts_23_379_10.19.2.2 (Ad hoc group call request return, MCPTT server-client). In each it is a mandatory IE indicating if authorization is success or failure. It also appears in ts_23_280_10.10.3.2.2a (Ad hoc group emergency alert request return), ts_23_280_10.10.3.2.4a (Ad hoc group emergency alert cancel request return), ts_23_700-76_7.1.2.2 (Ad hoc group communication request return (MC service server – MC service client)).
questions.reference_answer_legacy: The 'Authorization result' IE is defined in ts_23_281_7.19.2.2 (Ad hoc group call request return, MCVideo server-client), ts_23_282_7.17.2.2 (Ad hoc group data session request return, MCData server-client), ts_23_379_10.6.2.2.48 (Preconfigured regroup request return, MCPTT server-client), and ts_23_379_10.19.2.2 (Ad hoc group call request return, MCPTT server-client). In each it is a mandatory IE indicating if authorization is success or failure.

questions.question: In which specification clauses is the "DGANSS Reference Time" information element defined?
questions.reference_answer: The "DGANSS Reference Time" IE is defined within the DGANSS Corrections IE in ts_25_423_9.2.1.102 (RNSAP), ts_25_433_9.2.1.88 (NBAP), and ts_25_453_9.2.2.113 (PCAP), in each case as a mandatory INTEGER(0..3570 by step of 30) in seconds, representing the time in GNSS system time (modulo 3600 s) when the DGANSS corrections were calculated.

questions.question: Where is the 'Callback URL' parameter of the create notification channel response defined, in the MCData, SEAL/CAPIF architecture and the SEAL notification management stage-3 specification?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Callback URL' parameter of the create notification channel response is defined in ts_23_282_7.13.3.1.33 (MCData, mandatory, the URL used by the Message notification client to subscribe to MCData message store notifications), ts_23_434_17.3.2.2 (SEAL/CAPIF architecture, mandatory, the URL shared to the VAL server by the VAL client for sending notifications to the notification management server), and ts_24_542_A.1.3 (SEAL notification management stage-3, required, notified to the VAL client by SNM-C and then shared by the VAL client to the VAL server when subscribing). It also appears in ts_23_282_7.13.3.1.35 (Subscribe for notification request).
questions.reference_answer_legacy: The 'Callback URL' parameter of the create notification channel response is defined in ts_23_282_7.13.3.1.33 (MCData, mandatory, the URL used by the Message notification client to subscribe to MCData message store notifications), ts_23_434_17.3.2.2 (SEAL/CAPIF architecture, mandatory, the URL shared to the VAL server by the VAL client for sending notifications to the notification management server), and ts_24_542_A.1.3 (SEAL notification management stage-3, required, notified to the VAL client by SNM-C and then shared by the VAL client to the VAL server when subscribing).

questions.question: Which parts of the corpus specify the 'Channel type' parameter indicating PULL or PUSH delivery of notification messages in the create notification channel request?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Channel type' parameter, indicating PULL or PUSH delivery of notification messages in the create notification channel request, is specified in ts_23_434_17.3.2.1 (SEAL/CAPIF, mandatory) and ts_24_542_A.1.2 (SEAL notification management stage-3, required, encoded as 0x01 PUSH TYPE / 0x02 PULL TYPE). It also appears in ts_23_018_8.1.20 (Page MS via SGSN), ts_23_018_8.1.35 (Search for MS via SGSN).
questions.reference_answer_legacy: The 'Channel type' parameter, indicating PULL or PUSH delivery of notification messages in the create notification channel request, is specified in ts_23_434_17.3.2.1 (SEAL/CAPIF, mandatory) and ts_24_542_A.1.2 (SEAL notification management stage-3, required, encoded as 0x01 PUSH TYPE / 0x02 PULL TYPE).

questions.question: The 'Call Stop Time' information element can be requested in the Requested Information Type List. Which CAMEL and charging clauses define it?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Call Stop Time' IE, requestable in the Requested Information Type List, is defined in ts_23_078_4.6.2.4.2 and ts_23_278_4.7.2.3.2 (both Information Elements clauses, indicating it is the time stamp when the connection is released, requested in the Call Information Report) for CAMEL. It is also referenced within the VCS charging information structure of ts_32_276_6.3.1.2.

questions.question: In which specification clauses is the "Carrier List" information element defined?
questions.reference_answer: The "Carrier List" information element is defined within the SUL Information IE in ts_36_423_9.2.123 (X2AP), ts_38_423_9.2.2.18 (XnAP), and ts_38_473_9.3.1.28 (F1AP), in each case an optional NR Carrier List reference that, if included, means the SUL Transmission Bandwidth IE shall be ignored.

questions.question: Where is the 'Warning Security Information' information element of the WRITE-REPLACE / WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST message defined, in the UTRAN, E-UTRAN and NG-RAN warning message specifications?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Warning Security Information' IE of the WRITE-REPLACE / WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST message is defined in ts_25_419_9.1.3 (UTRAN, WRITE-REPLACE, optional, see TS 23.041), ts_36_413_9.1.13.1 (E-UTRAN, WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST, optional, see TS 23.041), and ts_38_413_9.2.8.1 (NG-RAN, WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST, optional OCTET STRING(SIZE(50)), noted as not used in the specification and ignored if received).

questions.question: The 'Source to Target Transparent Container' IE passes RAN-specific handover information transparently through the core network - in which clauses is it defined, in RANAP, S1AP and NGAP?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Source to Target Transparent Container' IE is defined in ts_25_413_9.2.1.30a (RANAP), ts_36_413_9.2.1.56 (S1AP, as 'Source To Target Transparent Container'), and ts_38_413_9.3.1.20 (NGAP). In each it is a mandatory OCTET STRING produced by the source RAN node and transmitted to the target RAN node, transparent to the core network, which may carry the equivalent transparent container of another RAT system (e.g. Source RNC to Target RNC, Source eNB to Target eNB, or Source NG-RAN Node to Target NG-RAN Node Transparent Container).

questions.question: The 'Protected E-UTRA Resource Indication' appears within served cell information. In which X2AP, XnAP and F1AP clauses is it specified?
questions.reference_answer: The 'Protected E-UTRA Resource Indication' is specified within Served Cell Information in ts_36_423_9.2.8 (X2AP), within Served Cell Information E-UTRA in ts_38_423_9.2.2.12 (XnAP), and within Served E-UTRA Cell Information in ts_38_473_9.3.1.64 (F1AP). It indicates which E-UTRA control/reference signal resources are protected and not subject to E-UTRA-NR Cell Resource Coordination.

questions.question: In which specification clauses is the "RSPP Transport Link Aggregate Bit Rates" information element defined?
questions.reference_answer: The "RSPP Transport Link Aggregate Bit Rates" IE is defined within the RSPP Transport QoS Parameters IE in ts_38_413_9.3.1.270 (NGAP), ts_38_423_9.2.3.209 (XnAP), and ts_38_473_9.3.1.332 (F1AP), in each case an optional Bit Rate field that only applies for Non-GBR QoS flows.

questions.question: Which clauses define the Usage enumeration for the type of usage made of a location measurement from the UE, with values such as SUCCESS_RESULTS_USED_TO_VERIFY_LOCATION and SUCCESS_METHOD_NOT_DETERMINED?
questions.reference_answer: The Usage enumeration, representing the type of usage made of the location measurement from the UE, is defined in ts_29_572_6.1.6.3.9 with values "UNSUCCESS", "SUCCESS_RESULTS_NOT_USED", "SUCCESS_RESULTS_USED_TO_VERIFY_LOCATION", "SUCCESS_RESULTS_USED_TO_GENERATE_LOCATION", and "SUCCESS_METHOD_NOT_DETERMINED". It is also defined in ts_33_128_7.3.3.2.55 (derived from the TS 29.572 type) with values unsuccess(1), successResultsNotUsed(2), successResultsUsedToVerifyLocation(3), successResultsUsedToGenerateLocation(4), and successMethodNotDetermined(5).

questions.question: Where is the VerticalDirection enumeration and its values defined?
questions.reference_answer: The VerticalDirection enumeration, representing the direction (upward/downward) of the vertical speed, is defined in ts_29_572_6.1.6.3.13 with values "UPWARD" and "DOWNWARD", and in ts_33_128_7.3.3.2.56 (derived from the TS 29.572 type) with values upward(1) and downward(2).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define a ServiceAnnouncementMode enumeration - one giving MBS User Service Announcement modes such as VIA_MBS_5, and one giving the BM-SC modes SACH and CONTENT_PROVIDER.
questions.reference_answer: The ServiceAnnouncementMode enumeration for MBS User Service Announcement modes (VIA_MBS_5, VIA_MBS_DISTRIBUTION_SESSION, PASSED_BACK) is defined in ts_29_580_6.1.6.3.3. The ServiceAnnouncementMode enumeration for BM-SC modes (SACH, CONTENT_PROVIDER) is defined in ts_29_122_5.8.3.1.2.3.

questions.question: Which clauses define the RevocationResult enumeration and its values?
questions.reference_answer: The RevocationResult enumeration, representing the monitoring Revocation Result for ProSe Service, is defined in ts_29_555_6.1.6.3.5 with values "SUCCESSFUL" and "FAILED". A separate RevocationResult enumeration, for the revocation result of Banned RPAUID/PDUID sets in Restricted ProSe Direct Discovery, is defined in ts_29_557_6.1.6.3.6 with values REVOCATION_SUCCESSFUL and REVOCATION_NOT_SUCCESSFUL.

questions.question: Which clause lists the TDoc status values such as 'reserved', and which other clause defines the NRF Status enumeration with values OPERATIVE and NON_OPERATIVE?
questions.reference_answer: The TDoc status values, including 'reserved', are listed in ts_21_900_9.2 (Table 9.2-1). The NRF Status enumeration with values "OPERATIVE" and "NON_OPERATIVE" is defined in ts_29_510_6.4.6.3.2.

questions.question: Tell me where the mapping of PID values in the PDCP PDU header is specified, including the general mapping rules and the specific mapping for the RFC 2507 and RFC 3095 header compression protocols.
questions.reference_answer: The general mapping rules for PID values in the PDCP PDU header are specified in ts_25_323_5.1.1 (e.g. PID "0" means "no compression", values mapped in ascending order from 1 per configured header compression protocol). The specific mapping for RFC 2507 is in ts_25_323_5.1.2.2 (PID values n+1 to n+5 for Full header, Compressed TCP, Compressed TCP non-delta, Compressed non-TCP, Context state), and for RFC 3095 (ROHC) in ts_25_323_5.1.3.3 (PID value n+1 for ROHC packet format).

questions.question: Where is the retransmission sequence number RSN, a two-bit value signalled from the UE to the Node B to indicate the redundancy version of each HARQ transmission, specified for FDD and for TDD?
questions.reference_answer: The retransmission sequence number (RSN) is specified for FDD in ts_25_212_4.9.2.2 (Information field mapping of retransmission sequence number), and for TDD in ts_25_222_4.9.1.3.1 (same clause title). In both, RSN is a two-bit value signalled from the UE to the Node B to indicate the redundancy version (RV) of each HARQ transmission and to assist Node B soft buffer management.

questions.question: In which clause is the Message Type information element of the Nq application protocol, and its value assignments, defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Message Type information element of the Nq application protocol, and its value assignments, is defined in ts_29_405_9.2 (Table 9.2-1): value 0 Reserved, 1 NqAP-IMSI-APN-INFORMATION-REQUEST, 2 NqAP-IMSI-APN-INFORMATION-RESPONSE, 3 NqAP-APN-INFORMATION-REQUEST, 4 NqAP-APN-INFORMATION-RESPONSE, and 5-255 Spare.

questions.question: For an EPS to 5GS handover over N26, where is the Namf_Communication_RelocateUEContext service operation used by an initial AMF to relocate the UE context in a target AMF specified?
questions.reference_answer: The Namf_Communication_RelocateUEContext service operation is specified in ts_23_502_5.2.2.2.21, used by an initial AMF to relocate the UE context in a target AMF during EPS to 5GS handover (per N26) procedures.

questions.question: Which specifications define the CommonEASDNAI attribute, and what does it identify?
questions.reference_answer: The CommonEASDNAI feature/attribute is defined in ts_29_504_6.1.8 (Nudr_DataRepository API, indicating support of the common EAS/DNAI selection per TS 29.519), ts_29_508_5.8 (Nsmf_EventExposure API, indicating support of enhancements of UP path change event notification), ts_29_514_5.8 (Naf_TrafficInfluence API, controlling support of the common EAS/DNAI selection, requiring the InfluenceOnTrafficRouting feature), and ts_29_522_5.4.4 (Used Features for TrafficInfluence API, controlling support of the common EAS/DNAI selection).

questions.question: Which parts of the corpus specify the Nbsf_Management_Registration service operation?
questions.reference_answer: The Nbsf_Management_Registration service operation is specified in ts_29_521_4.2.2.1, allowing an NF service consumer (e.g. PCF for a PDU session, PCF for a UE, or PCF for an MBS session) to register session binding information (user identity, DNN, UE address(es), selected PCF address) in the BSF, which then stores the information.

questions.question: Which documents specify the maxReportNbr attribute, and what values can it take?
questions.reference_answer: The maxReportNbr attribute (type Uinteger) is defined in Type NsmfEventExposure (ts_29_508_5.6.2.2), Type TimeSyncExposureSubsc (ts_29_522_5.15.4.3.2 and ts_29_565_6.1.6.2.2), Type ReportingInformation (ts_29_523_5.6.2.4), and Type AmEventData (ts_29_534_5.6.2.8). It represents the maximum number of reports after which the subscription ceases to exist; it may be present for the "PERIODIC" and "ON_EVENT_DETECTION" notification methods, and if omitted there is no limit.

questions.question: The Interfaces To Trace information element controls which interfaces are traced - in which specifications is it defined, and what can be selected in each bitmap?
questions.reference_answer: The Interfaces To Trace IE is defined in ts_36_413_9.2.1.4 (S1AP) and ts_36_423_9.2.2 (X2AP), where the 8-bit bitmap selects S1-MME, X2, Uu, F1-C, and E1 (bits 1-5, other bits reserved), and in ts_37_483_9.3.1.68 (W1AP), ts_38_423_9.2.3.55 (XnAP), and ts_38_473_9.3.1.88 (F1AP), where the bitmap instead selects NG-C, Xn-C, Uu, F1-C, and E1 (bits 1-5, other bits reserved). In each case, value '1' indicates 'should be traced' and value '0' indicates 'should not be traced'.

questions.question: The WLCP BEARER SETUP REQUEST message is what the TWAG sends to start a WLCP bearer on the trusted WLAN leg. In which clauses is it defined, and what does the TWAG have to put in it?
questions.reference_answer: The WLCP BEARER SETUP REQUEST message is defined across ts_24_244_5.10.2.1 (initiation by the TWAG), ts_24_244_5.10.2.2 (accepted by the UE), ts_24_244_5.10.2.3 (not accepted by the UE), ts_24_244_5.10.3 (abnormal cases in the UE), ts_24_244_5.10.4 (abnormal cases in the TWAG), and ts_24_244_7.13.1 (Message definition, giving its full IE table). The TWAG must include: WLCP bearer identity, PDN connection ID, MAC address of the TWAG (for the WLCP bearer), Bearer level QoS and TFT, plus (per the message definition table) User Plane Connection ID and optionally Protocol configuration options.

questions.question: Where is the USER PLANE CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT FAILURE message specified, and which failure cause values may it carry?
questions.reference_answer: The USER PLANE CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT FAILURE message is described in ts_24_572_6.2.1.1.5 (generated by the UE when the USER PLANE CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT COMMAND cannot be accepted), ts_24_572_6.2.1.1.7 (abnormal cases), ts_24_572_10.3.3.1 (Message definition), ts_24_572_12.3 (timers), and ts_24_572_A (call flow). It may carry Failure cause values: #1 "PDU session failure", #2 "TLS connection failure", #3 "LCS-UP connection binding failure", #4 "User plane not available", or #111 "Protocol error, unspecified".

questions.question: Tell me where the A2X DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE RESPONSE message is described and what the target UE echoes back in it.
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE RESPONSE message is described in ts_24_577_6.1.2.8.3 (target UE creates and sends it), ts_24_577_6.1.2.8.4 (completion by the initiating UE), ts_24_577_6.1.2.8.5.1 (abnormal cases), and ts_24_577_11.2.14.1 (Message definition). In the message, the target UE echoes back the keep-alive counter set to the same value received in the A2X DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message.

questions.question: When the BTS cannot carry out a notification commanded by the BSC it returns an ERROR REPORT message — in which clauses is that message specified?
questions.reference_answer: The ERROR REPORT message, returned when the BTS cannot carry out a notification commanded by the BSC, is specified in ts_48_058_5.8 (Notification procedure, where the BTS returns it if it cannot perform the commanded notification), and its general use is described in ts_48_058_4.4 (start of encryption, similar TRX error case), ts_48_058_6.4 (Error reporting procedure), ts_48_058_7.1 (General, listing ERROR REPORT as one of the reports BTS can send), ts_48_058_8.6 (TRX Management Messages, listing ERROR REPORT), and ts_48_058_9.2 (Message Type, coding ERROR REPORT as bit pattern 1100 under TRX Management messages).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message used on the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay link.
questions.reference_answer: The DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message (PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT), used on the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay link, is defined in ts_24_554_8a.2.8 (Ethernet traffic support context), ts_24_554_8a.2.10.3 (accepted by the target UE), ts_24_554_8a.2.10.4 (completion by the initiating UE), and ts_24_554_10.3.36.1 (Message definition), sent by the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE to a target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE to accept a PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

questions.question: For call setup towards the VLR, where is the SEND INFORMATION FOR OUTGOING CALL SETUP message defined and in which supplementary-service flows does it appear?
questions.reference_answer: The SEND INFORMATION FOR OUTGOING CALL SETUP message (MSC to VLR) appears in ts_29_011_5.1.1.2 (CLIR), ts_29_011_5.1.1.3 (COLP), ts_29_011_5.1.2.1 (Notification to served mobile subscriber for Call Forwarding), ts_29_011_5.1.4.1 (Explicit invocation of a CUG call), ts_29_011_5.1.4.3 (Notification of rejection of CUG invocation to served MS), and ts_29_011_5.1.6.1 (Barring of outgoing calls). In each, it is sent from the MSC to the VLR at mobile-originated call setup to obtain supplementary-service information (e.g. via the MAP_COMPLETE_CALL or MAP_SEND_INFO_FOR_OUTGOING_CALL primitives).

questions.question: Which documents specify the PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT RESPONSE message, and what is carried inside it?
questions.reference_answer: The PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT RESPONSE message is specified in ts_24_554_8.2.9.3 (generated by the target UE), ts_24_554_8.2.9.4 (completion by the initiating UE), ts_24_554_10.3.27.1 (Message definition), and ts_24_554_10.3.27.2 (EAP message IE). It carries an EAP message IE, set to the EAP message provided by the upper layers in response to the received EAP message, used for external DN authentication.

questions.question: The FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST message appears in the MCData file-distribution flow — where is it specified and how is a download accept or reject signalled?
questions.reference_answer: The FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST message's accept/reject/deferred signalling is specified in ts_24_282_6.2.3.2 (MCData client generating an FD notification) and ts_24_282_6.3.8.1 (participating MCData function generating an FD notification), with the download outcome carried in the FD disposition notification type IE of the FD NOTIFICATION message, set to "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST ACCEPTED", "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST REJECTED", or "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST DEFERRED". ts_24_282_12.2.2.1 and ts_24_282_12.2.3 describe the participating/controlling MCData function's handling of the resulting SDS/FD disposition notification.

questions.question: In which clauses is the PROSE ADDITIONAL PARAMETERS ANNOUNCEMENT REQUEST message defined, and what triggers a layer-3 remote UE to send it?
questions.reference_answer: The PROSE ADDITIONAL PARAMETERS ANNOUNCEMENT REQUEST message is defined in ts_24_554_8.2.8.2 (initiation by the 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE), ts_24_554_8.2.8.3 (accepted by the UE-to-network relay UE), ts_24_554_8.2.8.5.1 (abnormal cases), and ts_24_554_10.3.24.1 (Message definition). A layer-3 remote UE sends it when triggered by an upper layer application to report NCGI or TAI of the serving cell but cannot obtain it via the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message, or when the additional parameters announcement request refresh timer T5106 expires and the remote UE still needs the NCGI or TAI.

questions.question: When a serving NF needs to refresh the UE context it registered with the UDM, which specifications describe Nudm_UECM_Update and who invokes it?
questions.reference_answer: Nudm_UECM_Update is described in ts_23_502_5.2.3.2.5 (service operation definition: consumer updates UE-related information such as UE capabilities, intersystem continuity context, SMF+PGW-C FQDN, or Analytics ID(s)). It is invoked by: the NWDAF containing AnLF, to modify its analytics registration (ts_29_552_5.8.3.2.2); the AMF, to update the RAT type of a target non-3GPP access (ts_23_700-53_6.7.4) and to provide the "Homogeneous Support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions" indication (ts_23_501_5.16.3.3); the SMSF, to indicate UE memory capacity available for SMS (ts_23_540_5.1.8); and the SMF, to update UPF information for a registered PDU session (ts_23_700-62_6.5.3).

questions.question: Where is the DEFERRED DATA RESPONSE message described, and is it supported by the IWF?
questions.reference_answer: The DEFERRED DATA RESPONSE message is described in ts_24_282_15.1.12.1 (Message definition: sent by the MCData server to the MCData UE in response to a list of deferred group communications request). It is not supported by the IWF: ts_29_582_15.1.12 states "The IWF does not support the DEFERRED DATA RESPONSE message."

questions.question: Tell me where the MANAGE USER PLANE NODE COMPLETE message is specified and which IEs the NW-TT fills in when it answers a 'get capabilities' operation.
questions.reference_answer: The MANAGE USER PLANE NODE COMPLETE message is specified in ts_24_539_6.3.1.3 (procedure completion) and ts_24_539_8.8.1 (Message definition), sent by the NW-TT to the TSN AF. For a "get capabilities" operation, the NW-TT includes the list of User plane node management parameters it supports in the User plane node management capability IE of the message.

questions.question: Which specifications define the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY RESPONSE message, and what identity does the target UE return in it for an emergency direct link?
questions.reference_answer: TS 24.554 defines the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY RESPONSE message (clauses 7.2.14.3, 7.2.14.4, 10.3.35.1, and the timer clause 12.3). For an emergency direct link, the target UE includes the UE identity IE set to the IMEI or IMEISV, as requested in the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY REQUEST message.

questions.question: When the target UE refuses an A2X unicast link, the A2X DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message is sent — where is it specified and which PC5 signalling cause values can it carry?
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message is specified in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.2.5 and 11.2.3.1. It can carry PC5 signalling protocol cause value #1 "direct communication to the target UE not allowed", #3 "conflict of layer-2 ID for unicast communication is detected", #5 "lack of resources for A2X PC5 unicast link", or #111 "protocol error, unspecified".

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the WLCP BEARER MODIFY REQUEST message and the timer the TWAG starts when it sends one.
questions.reference_answer: The WLCP BEARER MODIFY REQUEST message is defined in TS 24.244, clauses 5.11.2.1 and 7.16.1. When the TWAG sends it, the TWAG starts timer T3588 and enters the state WLCP BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING.

questions.question: For PC5-to-Uu path switching, where is the PROSE PATH SWITCHING ACCEPT message defined?
questions.reference_answer: The PROSE PATH SWITCHING ACCEPT message is defined in TS 24.554, clauses 7.7.3.3, 7.7.3.4, and 10.3.31.1 (with the message type code listed in 11.3.1).

questions.question: Where is the LCS-UP CONNECTION BINDING REJECT message specified, and what does the LMF do with the binding ID after sending it?
questions.reference_answer: The LCS-UP CONNECTION BINDING REJECT message is specified in TS 24.572, clauses 7.3.4.5 and 10.2.5.1. After sending it, the LMF releases the LCS-UP binding ID value indicated in the LCS-UP CONNECTION BINDING REQUEST message and its association with the UE.

questions.question: In which clauses is the DATA INDICATION message of the GSM voice group call service defined?
questions.reference_answer: The DATA INDICATION message of the GSM voice group call service is defined in TS 43.068, clauses 4.2.8.2.1 (by the talking service subscriber), 4.2.8.2.2 (by a listener), and 4.2.8.4.1 (distribution via the MSC); clause 7.2 covers the radio channels used for it.

questions.question: Which documents specify the A2X DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message?
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK REKEYING RESPONSE message is specified in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.10.3, 6.1.2.10.4, 11.2.23.1, and the timer clause 13.3 (timer T5311).

questions.question: Tell me where the A2X DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message is described and what the responding UE confirms with it.
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message is described in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.3.4 and 11.2.5.1. With it, the responding UE confirms acceptance of the requested modification: adding a new A2X service, adding or modifying PC5 QoS flow(s), or removing an existing A2X service/QoS flow(s) from the A2X PC5 unicast link, providing the corresponding PQFI(s) to the lower layer.

questions.question: To find out which NF is currently serving a UE, which specifications describe Nudm_UECM_Get and what does the consumer receive?
questions.reference_answer: Nudm_UECM_Get is described in TS 23.502 (clause 5.2.3.2.4, the service operation definition), TS 29.552 (clause 5.8.3.3), TS 33.741 (clause 5.9.2), TS 33.326 (clause 4.2.2), TS 23.700-71 (clause 6.6.3), and TS 23.700-62 (clause 6.5.3). The consumer receives the NF ID (or SMS address) of the NF serving the UE for the requested NF type — e.g. the current serving AMF's ID/details, or the NWDAF instance information registered for the UE — and optionally the corresponding Access Type, Analytics ID(s), SUPI/GPSI, or already-registered PDU Session ID(s).

questions.question: For LCS user-plane binding, where is the LCS-UP CONNECTION BINDING REQUEST message defined and what does the UE include in it?
questions.reference_answer: The LCS-UP CONNECTION BINDING REQUEST message is defined in TS 24.572, clauses 7.3.4.2 and 10.2.3.1 (with timer clause 12.2). The UE includes the LCS-UP binding ID value received during the network initiated user plane connection establishment procedure.

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the A2X DIRECT LINK RELEASE ACCEPT message.
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK RELEASE ACCEPT message is defined in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.4.4 and 11.2.8.1.

questions.question: Where is the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION message specified, and what may the initiating UE change with it?
questions.reference_answer: Clause 7.2.3.4/7.2.3.4a and the message-definition clause 10.3.7a.1 of TS 24.554 cover the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure. With a PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST, the initiating UE may add a new ProSe application, add new PC5 QoS flow(s), modify existing PC5 QoS flow(s), or remove an existing ProSe application or PC5 QoS flow(s) from the 5G ProSe direct link.

questions.question: Which specifications define the A2X DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REJECT message and the cause values it can carry?
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is defined in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.6.5 and 11.2.17.1. It carries PC5 signalling protocol cause value #6 "authentication failure" or #5 "lack of resources for A2X PC5 unicast link".

questions.question: For NR performance measurement counting, where is the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP message referenced and what is measured about it?
questions.reference_answer: In TS 28.552, the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP message (per TS 38.413) is referenced in clauses 5.1.1.10.1/5.1.1.10.2 (number of DRBs attempted/successfully setup, on receipt/transmission of PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST/RESPONSE at the gNB) and clauses 5.8.1.1.1/5.8.1.1.2/5.8.1.1.3 (number of PDU Sessions requested to setup, successfully setup, and failed to setup at the N3IWF, based on PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST/RESPONSE).

questions.question: In which clauses is the PROSE ADDITIONAL PARAMETERS ANNOUNCEMENT RESPONSE message defined?
questions.reference_answer: The PROSE ADDITIONAL PARAMETERS ANNOUNCEMENT RESPONSE message is defined in TS 24.554, clauses 8.2.8.4 and 10.3.25.1.

questions.question: Which documents specify the WT MODIFICATION message used over the Xw interface in LWA?
questions.reference_answer: The WT MODIFICATION (REQUIRED/CONFIRM/REFUSE) messages of the WT initiated WT Modification procedure over the Xw interface are specified in TS 36.463, clauses 8.9.4, 8.10.2, and 8.10.3, and described in TS 36.300, clause 22B.2.2.4.

questions.question: When an AF provisions subscriber parameters into the UDM, which specifications describe Nudm_ParameterProvision_Create?
questions.reference_answer: Nudm_ParameterProvision_Create is described in TS 23.502 (clause 5.2.3.6.3, the service operation definition), TS 23.700-28 (clauses 6.18.2/6.18.3), TS 23.700-48 (clause 6.14.4), TS 23.700-74 (clause 6.12.3), and TS 23.700-80 (clause 6.29.2.1). The consumer uses it to create a Network Configuration with one or more parameters, 5G VN group related information, or Multicast MBS related information.

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the INFORMATION TRANSFER INDICATION message on RANAP.
questions.reference_answer: Clauses 8.32.3 and 9.1.52 of TS 25.413 relate to the INFORMATION TRANSFER INDICATION message on RANAP, in the context of the Information Transfer procedure and its unsuccessful response, the INFORMATION TRANSFER FAILURE message. The message definition also appears in ts_25_413_9.1.51 (INFORMATION TRANSFER CONFIRMATION; Direction: RNC → CN.).
questions.reference_answer_legacy: Clauses 8.32.3 and 9.1.52 of TS 25.413 relate to the INFORMATION TRANSFER INDICATION message on RANAP, in the context of the Information Transfer procedure and its unsuccessful response, the INFORMATION TRANSFER FAILURE message.

questions.question: Where is the PORT MANAGEMENT NOTIFY COMPLETE message of the TSN port-management procedure specified?
questions.reference_answer: The PORT MANAGEMENT NOTIFY COMPLETE message is specified in TS 24.539, clauses 5.2.2.4, 5.2.2.6, 8.5.1.1, and the message type table in clause 9.1.

questions.question: In which clauses is the AUDIT REQUEST message of NBAP defined?
questions.reference_answer: The AUDIT REQUEST message of NBAP is defined in TS 25.433, clauses 8.2.7.2 and 9.2.1.56B (the Start Of Audit Sequence Indicator IE).

questions.question: Tell me where the GA-PSR HANDOVER COMPLETE message of GAN packet-switched resources is described.
questions.reference_answer: The GA-PSR HANDOVER COMPLETE message of GAN packet-switched resources is described in TS 43.129, clauses 5.8.1.2 and 6.1.2.2.

questions.question: Which specifications define the USER PLANE CONNECTION RELEASE COMPLETE message for the LCS user plane?
questions.reference_answer: The USER PLANE CONNECTION RELEASE COMPLETE message for the LCS user plane is defined in TS 24.572, clauses 6.2.1.2.3 and 10.3.7.1.

questions.question: For 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay security, where is the DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message specified?
questions.reference_answer: The PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message is specified in TS 24.554, clauses 8a.2.10.5 and 10.3.38.1.

questions.question: Where is the DELIVERY REPORT RECEIVED REQUEST message of the 5G ProSe messaging service defined?
questions.reference_answer: The DELIVERY REPORT RECEIVED REQUEST message of the 5G ProSe (MSGin5G) messaging service is defined in TS 24.538, clauses 6.4.2.2.3, A.2.1.4, A.2.2.1 (message type coding), and A.3.2.4 (JSON schema).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the POSITION INITIATION REQUEST message on PCAP.
questions.reference_answer: The POSITION INITIATION REQUEST message on PCAP is described in TS 25.453, clause 8.8.2 (Position Initiation procedure, successful operation), sent from the SRNC to the SAS to initiate the Position Initiation procedure.

questions.question: The WLCP BEARER SETUP REJECT message is returned when the UE cannot accept a WLCP bearer — in which clauses is it specified?
questions.reference_answer: The WLCP BEARER SETUP REJECT message is specified in TS 24.244, clauses 5.10.2.3 (procedure not accepted by the UE), 5.10.3 (abnormal cases), 7.15.1 (message definition), and 9.1 (timers).

questions.question: Which documents specify the PDN DISCONNECT ACCEPT message on the WLCP protocol?
questions.reference_answer: The PDN DISCONNECT ACCEPT message on WLCP is specified in TS 24.244, clauses 5.4.2 and 7.5.1.

questions.question: An AF wants to change the QoS of an ongoing session through the NEF. Which specifications describe Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Update?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Update is described in TS 23.502 (clause 4.15.6.6a, referenced by the other documents), TS 28.552 (clauses 5.9.10.2.1-5.9.10.2.3, measurements at the NEF), TS 23.700-62 (clause 6.19.3.1), TS 23.700-60 (clause 6.32.3.2), and TS 23.700-80 (clause 6.35.2).

questions.question: Tell me where the TO UE RELAY UPDATE ACCEPT message is defined in the 5G ProSe direct-link procedures.
questions.reference_answer: The PROSE UE TO UE RELAY UPDATE ACCEPT message is defined in TS 24.554, clauses 7.2.13.3, 7.2.13.4, and 10.3.29.1 (with the message type code listed in 11.3.1).

questions.question: Where is the RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message referenced in the GPRS/GSM mobility management procedures of TS 24.008?
questions.reference_answer: In TS 24.008, the RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message is referenced in clause 4.4.1 (Location updating procedure) and clause 4.7.3 (GPRS attach procedure): for a shared UTRAN, the chosen PLMN identity shall be indicated to the UTRAN in the RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message.

questions.question: In which clauses is the A2X DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REJECT message defined?
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REJECT message is defined in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.3.5, 11.2.6.1, 12.3.1 (message type coding), and 13.3 (timers).

questions.question: Which specifications define the MESSAGE SENDING REQUEST message of the 5G ProSe messaging service?
questions.reference_answer: The MESSAGE SENDING REQUEST message of the 5G ProSe (MSGin5G) messaging service is defined in TS 24.538, clauses 6.4.2.2.2, 6.4.2.3.1, A.2.2.1 (message type coding), and A.3.2.1 (JSON schema). The message definition also appears in ts_24_538_A.2.1.1 (for sending a message to MSGin5G Client; Direction: the Application Client residing on another UE to the MSGin5G Client of the MSGin).
questions.reference_answer_legacy: The MESSAGE SENDING REQUEST message of the 5G ProSe (MSGin5G) messaging service is defined in TS 24.538, clauses 6.4.2.2.2, 6.4.2.3.1, A.2.2.1 (message type coding), and A.3.2.1 (JSON schema).

questions.question: For inter-MSC handover, where is the IU RELEASE message described in the interworking specification TS 29.010?
questions.reference_answer: In TS 29.010, the IU RELEASE message context appears in clauses 4.6.2 (Subsequent Inter-MSC Handover from 3G-MSC-B back to MSC-A), 4.7.3 (Subsequent Inter-MSC Handover to third MSC), 4.8.2 (Subsequent Inter-MSC Relocation back to 3G-MSC-A), and 4.8.3 (Subsequent Inter-MSC Relocation to third MSC).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the A2X DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
questions.reference_answer: The A2X DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message is defined in TS 24.577, clauses 6.1.2.6.5A and 11.2.18.1.

questions.question: For off-network SEAL location management, where is the LOCATION REPORTING TRIGGER CONFIGURATION REQUEST message specified?
questions.reference_answer: The LOCATION REPORTING TRIGGER CONFIGURATION REQUEST message for off-network SEAL location management is specified in TS 24.545, clauses 6.3.2.1.1 (client originating procedure), 6.3.2.1.2 (client terminating procedure), and 8.2.2 (message type coding).

questions.question: Where is the S-NODE RELEASE REQUIRED message of the XnAP S-NG-RAN node release procedure defined?
questions.reference_answer: The S-NODE RELEASE REQUIRED message of the XnAP S-NG-RAN node release procedure is defined in TS 38.423, clauses 8.3.7.2 and 9.3.4 (part 2), and referenced in TS 38.401, clause 8.9.17.2.2.

questions.question: The X2 SETUP REQUEST message carries an eNB's complete list of served cells to a candidate peer — in which clauses is it specified?
questions.reference_answer: The X2 SETUP REQUEST message is specified in TS 36.423, clauses 8.3.3.2 (successful operation), 8.3.3.4 (abnormal conditions), and 9.3.4 (PDU definitions).

questions.question: Tell me where the SIDELINK POSITIONING PRIVACY CHECK ACCEPT message is defined and what the target UE echoes in it.
questions.reference_answer: The SIDELINK POSITIONING PRIVACY CHECK ACCEPT message is defined in TS 24.514, clauses 7.4.4.3 and 10.4.5.1 (with the message type code in 11.4.1). In it, the target UE echoes the procedure transaction ID (PTI) received in the SIDELINK POSITIONING PRIVACY CHECK REQUEST message.

questions.question: Which specifications describe Nbsf_Management_Notify, and what event does the BSF report through it?
questions.reference_answer: Nbsf_Management_Notify is described in TS 23.502 (clauses 5.2.13.2.1 and 5.2.13.2.8), TS 29.521 (clauses 4.2.1 and 4.2.8.1), TS 29.513 (clause 8.5.10), and TS 23.700-62 (clause 6.22.3.2). The BSF uses it to notify NEF, AF, TSCTSF, or PCF of newly registered or deregistered PCF (binding) related events for the UE or PDU Session.

questions.question: In which clauses is the POSITIONING MEASUREMENT REPORT message of F1AP defined?
questions.reference_answer: The POSITIONING MEASUREMENT REPORT message of F1AP is defined in TS 38.473, clauses 8.13.4.2 (successful operation, where the gNB-DU sends the message containing positioning measurement results) and 9.4.4 part 5 (PDU definitions); clause 8.13.3.2 covers the related Positioning Measurement Request/Response procedure.

questions.question: Where is the Ndccf_DataManagement_Subscribe service operation specified, and how does a data consumer such as the NWDAF use it to collect data via the DCCF?
questions.reference_answer: Ndccf_DataManagement_Subscribe is specified in TS 29.552, clauses 5.5.1.1, 5.5.3.1, 5.5.3.2, and 5.10.2.1, and referenced from TS 23.288, clause 6.2.2.2. A data consumer such as NWDAF invokes Ndccf_DataManagement_Subscribe (an HTTP POST targeting the resource "DCCF Data Subscriptions") to subscribe to notifications of event exposure via the DCCF, based on the data consumer's local configuration of whether to contact the Data Source directly or go via the DCCF (optionally also via a Messaging Framework/MFAF).

questions.question: When the AF asks the 5GC to help pick member UEs, the Nnef_MemberUESelectionAssistance_Notify service operation reports the result — in which clauses is it defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_MemberUESelectionAssistance_Notify is defined in TS 23.502, clauses 4.15.13.1, 4.15.13.3.3, 4.15.13.5.2, 4.15.13.6.2, and 5.2.6.32.4.

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the Nnwdaf_AnalyticsSubscription_Transfer service operation.
questions.reference_answer: Nnwdaf_AnalyticsSubscription_Transfer is defined in TS 23.288, clauses 6.1B.2.2, 6.1B.2.3, 7.2.1, and 7.2.5.

questions.question: Which documents specify the Nnef_UCMFProvisioning_Update service operation, and what is measured about it?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_UCMFProvisioning_Update is specified in TS 23.502 (clause 5.2.6.17.4, the service operation definition) and TS 28.552 (clauses 5.9.11.2.1-5.9.11.2.3). TS 28.552 measures the number of UCMF dictionary entry update requests received by the NEF, the number of successful UCMF dictionary entry updates, and the number of failed UCMF dictionary entry updates (per failure cause).

questions.question: For network slice admission control, where is the Nnsacf_NSAC_EACNotify service operation defined and what does it tell the AMF?
questions.reference_answer: Nnsacf_NSAC_EACNotify is defined in TS 23.502, clauses 4.2.11.3 and 5.2.21.2.3 (with the related Nnsacf_NSAC_NumOfUEsUpdate operation in 5.2.21.2.2). The NSACF uses it to tell the AMF, for a given S-NSSAI subject to NSAC, whether Early Admission Control (EAC) mode is to be activated (when the number of UEs registered with the network slice is above an operator-defined threshold) or deactivated (when it falls below the threshold), via an EAC flag per S-NSSAI.

questions.question: Tell me where the Nnef_APISupportCapability_Subscribe service operation is described.
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_APISupportCapability_Subscribe is described in TS 23.502, clauses 4.11.6.1, 4.11.6.2, and 5.2.6.12.2.

questions.question: In which clauses is the Namf_EventExposure_UnSubscribe service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Namf_EventExposure_UnSubscribe is defined in TS 23.502, clauses 4.15.3.2.1, 5.2.2.3.1, and 5.2.2.3.3.

questions.question: Where is the Nhss_UEAuthentication_Get service operation specified in the HSS-UDM interworking architecture?
questions.reference_answer: Nhss_UEAuthentication_Get is specified in TS 23.632, clauses 5.2.1 (General), 5.2.2 (Vector Generation in HSS), and 6.1.2.1 (the service operation definition). The UDM uses it to retrieve a 5G authentication vector from the HSS when authentication subscription data is stored at the EPS-UDR and 5G vectors must be calculated in the HSS.

questions.question: The Nudm_UEAuthentication_GetHssAv service operation lets the UDM fetch an HSS authentication vector — in which clauses is it defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nudm_UEAuthentication_GetHssAv is defined in TS 23.632, clauses 5.2.1 (General), 5.2.3 (Vector Generation in UDM/ARPF), and 6.2.5.1 (the service operation definition). The HSS uses it to retrieve authentication vectors for EPS and/or IMS from the UDM when the subscriber's authentication subscription data is stored at the 5GS-UDR.

questions.question: Which parts of the corpus describe Nbsf_Management_Subscribe, and which NF typically subscribes?
questions.reference_answer: Nbsf_Management_Subscribe is described in TS 23.502 (clause 5.2.13.2.1 General and clause 5.2.13.2.6, the service operation definition), TS 29.521 (clauses 4.2.1 and 4.2.6.1), TS 29.513 (clause 8.5.8), and TS 23.700-62 (clause 6.22.3.2). It is typically invoked by an NF service consumer such as NEF, AF, PCF for the UE, or TSCTSF (and 5G DDNMF) to subscribe to notifications of newly registered or deregistered PCF for a PDU Session or for a UE.

questions.question: Which specifications define the Nhss_UECM_Update service operation?
questions.reference_answer: Nhss_UECM_Update is defined in TS 23.632, clauses 5.4.6 (IMEI Retrieval), 5.6.3 (Synchronization of Status of Monitoring Event between HSS and UDM), and 6.1.3.2 (the service operation definition).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the Nudm_EE_Subscribe service operation in the 5GS-EPS interworking architecture.
questions.reference_answer: In TS 23.632, Nudm_EE_Subscribe is used in clauses 5.5.2 (MT-SMS Routing Information Retrieval), 5.5.3 (MT-SMS Delivery Failure), and 5.5.6.3 (MT SMS delivery failure in 5GC only deployments) for the HSS (or HSS acting for IMS) to subscribe to UE-Reachability notification at the UDM; the operation's formal definition is given in TS 23.502.

questions.question: Where is the Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Destroy service operation specified?
questions.reference_answer: Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Destroy is specified in TS 29.580, clause 5.3.2.1 (service operation list) and TS 26.502, clause 7.2.3.4 (the service operation definition); it is invoked in TS 23.700-47, clause 6.13.3.3 when the NEF cancels a previously submitted group message using Service Mode.

questions.question: Tell me where the Nudm_ParameterProvision_UpdateNotify service operation is described.
questions.reference_answer: Nudm_ParameterProvision_UpdateNotify is described in TS 23.700-74, clauses 6.15.2 (Functional Description), 6.15.3 (Procedures), and 6.15.4 (Impacts on existing entities and interfaces). It is a new UDM service operation that allows the UDM to notify the NEF of changes to the 5G VN group data.

questions.question: In which clauses is the Npcf_GroupPolicyAuthorization_Create service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Npcf_GroupPolicyAuthorization_Create is defined in TS 23.700-80, clauses 6.42.1 (Description), 6.42.2 (Procedures), and 7.7 (Key Issue #7 evaluation). The NEF triggers this request towards the PCF, with UE address(es), AF Identifier, Flow description(s), AIML Group performance information, and AIML session indicator as input parameters, when multiple UEs from the AF group are served by the same PCF.

questions.question: Which documents specify the Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Retrieve service operation, and which consumer invokes it?
questions.reference_answer: Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Retrieve is specified in TS 29.580, clauses 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.2.3.1, and TS 26.502, clause 7.2.3.2 (the service operation definition). It is invoked by the AF or NEF (as NF service consumer) to retrieve the properties of an existing MBS User Data Ingest Session.

questions.question: For MBS user-data ingest, where is the Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Update service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Update is defined in TS 29.580, clauses 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.2.4.1, and TS 26.502, clause 7.2.3.3 (the service operation definition).

questions.question: Where is the Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_StatusUnsubscribe service operation specified?
questions.reference_answer: Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession_StatusUnsubscribe is specified in TS 29.580, clauses 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.2.8.1, and TS 26.502, clause 7.2.3.6 (the service operation definition).

questions.question: Tell me where the Ndcaf_DataReporting_DestroySession service operation is described, and what HTTP method the client uses for it.
questions.reference_answer: Ndcaf_DataReporting_DestroySession is described in TS 26.532, clauses 4.2.4.4 (Indirect Data Collection Client), 4.2.5.4 (Application Server), and 4.3.2.4 (Direct Data Collection Client). In all three cases, the client invokes the service operation by sending an HTTP DELETE request to the Data Collection AF, which acknowledges with a 204 No Content response.

questions.question: For UAS authentication and authorization, where is the Nnef_Auth_Req service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_Auth_Req is defined in TS 33.256, clauses 5.2.1.2 (UUAA Procedure at Registration, triggered by the AMF), 5.2.1.3 (UUAA Procedure during PDU Session Establishment, triggered by the SMF), and 5.2.2.2 (UUAA procedure, triggered by the SMF+PGW-C) — in each case, sent to the UAS NF including the GPSI and CAA-Level UAV ID.

questions.question: When the LMF has a location event to report, which specifications describe Nlmf_Location_EventNotify and who receives it?
questions.reference_answer: Nlmf_Location_EventNotify is described in TS 23.273 (clause 8.3.2.3, the service operation definition), TS 38.305 (clause 7.3.4), TS 28.552 (clauses 5.16.2.1 and 5.16.2.2), and TS 23.700-71 (clauses 6.29.3.1 and 6.3.3.2b). It is sent by the LMF to the consumer NF that implicitly subscribed via Nlmf_Location_DetermineLocation — e.g. the AMF or, for PRU information updates, the GMLC (directly or via the AMF) — to report a geodetic/local/civic location event, an activation success or failure, or a cancellation of periodic/triggered location reporting.

questions.question: The Nausf_SoRProtection_Protect service operation protects the steering-of-roaming list — in which clauses is it specified?
questions.reference_answer: Nausf_SoRProtection_Protect is specified in TS 33.501, clauses 6.14.2.1 (procedure for steering of UE in VPLMN during registration), 6.14.2.2 (procedure for steering of UE in VPLMN or HPLMN after registration), and 14.1.3 (the Nausf_SoRProtection service definition).

questions.question: Which specifications define the Nausf_UEAuthentication_ProseAuthenticate service operation, and what keying material does it return?
questions.reference_answer: Nausf_UEAuthentication_ProseAuthenticate is defined in TS 33.503, clauses 6.3.3.3.2, 7.3.1, and 7.3.2.1. On success, it returns the authentication result together with KNR_ProSe, Nonce_2, and CP-PRUK ID (or, during the EAP exchange, an EAP message).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the Nnef_MemberUESelectionAssistance_Subscribe service operation.
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_MemberUESelectionAssistance_Subscribe is defined in TS 23.502, clauses 4.15.13.1, 4.15.13.5.1, and 4.15.13.6.1.

questions.question: In which clauses is the Nnef_PFDManagement_Update service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_PFDManagement_Update is defined in TS 23.502, clause 5.2.6.3.7 (the service operation definition), and referenced in TS 28.552, clauses 5.9.2.2.1 and 5.9.2.2.2 (measurements of PFD update requests and successful updates at the NEF).

questions.question: Where is the Nnrf_NFManagement_NFStatusUnSubscribe service operation specified, and how does a consumer stop being notified of NF status changes?
questions.reference_answer: Nnrf_NFManagement_NFStatusUnSubscribe is specified in TS 23.502, clauses 4.17.7 (NF/NF service status subscribe/notify in the same PLMN) and 4.17.8 (across PLMNs). A consumer that previously invoked Nnrf_NFManagement_NFStatusSubscribe stops being notified of NF status changes by invoking the Nnrf_NFManagement_NFStatusUnSubscribe service operation.

questions.question: Which documents specify the Nnef_MBSSession_Delete service operation, and what does it delete for a location-dependent MBS session?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_MBSSession_Delete is specified in TS 23.247, clause 9.4.3.4 (the service operation definition), and TS 29.522, clause 4.4.29.3.4. For a location-dependent MBS session, it deletes the part of the MBS session within a specified service area (identified by an Area Session ID); otherwise it deletes the whole multicast or broadcast MBS session.

questions.question: Where is the Nlmf_Location_MeasurementData service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nlmf_Location_MeasurementData is defined in TS 23.273, clauses 6.17.4 and 8.3.2.6 (the service operation definition).

questions.question: Tell me where the Nudr_GroupIDmap_Query service operation is described.
questions.reference_answer: Nudr_GroupIDmap_Query is described in TS 29.831, clause 6.11.1: the NRF uses it to retrieve from the UDR the NF Group ID corresponding to a specific subscriber identifier (or Routing Indicator) when it has no locally stored mapping configuration.

questions.question: In which clauses is the Nsmf_PDUSession_TransferMOData service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nsmf_PDUSession_TransferMOData is defined in TS 23.502, clauses 4.25.4 (NEF Anchored Mobile Originated Data Transport) and 5.2.8.2.13 (the service operation definition).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the Nnef_NIDD_GroupDeliveryNotify service operation.
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_NIDD_GroupDeliveryNotify is defined in TS 23.502, clauses 4.25.9 (NEF Anchored Group NIDD via NEF anchored unicast MT data) and 5.2.6.14.4 (the service operation definition).

questions.question: Which documents specify Nnef_ParameterProvision_Update, and how does it differ from the UDM-facing provisioning operation?
questions.reference_answer: Nnef_ParameterProvision_Update is specified in TS 23.502 (clause 5.2.6.4.2, the service operation definition), TS 28.552 (clauses 5.9.6.2.1-5.9.6.2.3), TS 23.316 (clause 9.6.3), and TS 23.700-80 (clause 6.29.2.1). It is the NEF-facing operation an AF uses to update UE-related or 5G VN/Multicast MBS group information via the NEF, whereas the UDM-facing operation, Nudm_ParameterProvision_Update, is invoked by the NEF towards the UDM to actually create/update/store the provisioned parameters as part of the subscriber data.

questions.question: Which specifications define the Namf_Communication_AMFStatusChangeNotify service operation?
questions.reference_answer: The Namf_Communication_AMFStatusChangeNotify service operation is defined in 3GPP TS 29.518, clause 6.1.5.2, and described as a service operation in TS 23.502 clause 5.2.2.2.16, where it reports an AMF Status change (e.g. AMF unavailable) notification to subscribed NFs.

questions.question: Where is the Nnwdaf_MLAggregation_Terminate service operation specified?
questions.reference_answer: Nnwdaf_MLAggregation_Terminate is specified in TS 23.700-81, in clause 6.24.3.1 (the Nnwdaf_MLAggregation Service, Option 1), and is used in the Federated Learning procedure of clause 6.24.2.1, where the Server NWDAF invokes it to terminate the current FL training process at the Client NWDAF(s).

questions.question: Tell me where the Nnwdaf_DataRetrieval_Subscribe service operation is described.
questions.reference_answer: Nnwdaf_DataRetrieval_Subscribe is described in TS 23.700-81, clause 6.38.2.1 (HPLMN collecting data from VPLMN) and clause 6.38.3 (Impacts on Existing Nodes and Functionality), where it is offered by the V-NWDAF to enable event subscriptions based on the Subscribe/Notify model, alongside Nnwdaf_DataRetrieval_GET for one-time enquiries.

questions.question: For HSS-based parameter provisioning, where is the Nhss_ParameterProvision_Update service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nhss_ParameterProvision_Update is defined in TS 23.700-89, clauses 6.4.1 (Description) and 6.4.2 (Procedures), as a new service operation used by the UDM to provision the new "RFSP index in use" parameter and its validity time to the HSS.

questions.question: In which clauses is the Nsepp_Telescopic_Mapping service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Nsepp_Telescopic_Mapping (Nsepp_Telescopic_FQDN_Mapping) is defined in TS 29.573, clauses 6.3.4.1 (General, data model) and 6.3.5.3 (Application Errors).

questions.question: Which documents specify the Nudm_UEIdentifier_Deconceal service operation used for 5G ProSe remote-user identity resolution?
questions.reference_answer: Nudm_UEIdentifier_Deconceal is specified in TS 33.503, clause 7.4.3.1, where the Requester NF gets the SUPI from the UDM using SUCI as required input and SUPI as required output; it is used for 5G ProSe remote-user identity resolution as referenced in clause 6.3.3.2.2.

questions.question: Where is the Npkmf_PKMFKeyRequest_ProseKey service operation specified?
questions.reference_answer: Npkmf_PKMFKeyRequest_ProseKey is specified in TS 33.503, clauses 7.2.1 (General, service table) and 7.2.2.1 (service operation definition), where the 5G PKMF supports a key request from another 5G PKMF via this operation, providing ProSe related keying material.

questions.question: Point me to the clause that defines the Nlmf_Location_DeterminationLocation service operation.
questions.reference_answer: Nlmf_Location_DeterminationLocation is specified in TS 23.273, clause 6.21.1, where the AMF may invoke this service operation towards the LMF to request the current location of the UE.

questions.question: Where is the Nmfaf_ContextManagement_Transfer service operation specified?
questions.reference_answer: Nmfaf_ContextManagement_Transfer is specified in TS 23.288, clause 9.4.2, where it provides MFAF UE context to a consumer, taking Set of UE MFAF Context Identifier(s) as required input.

questions.question: Tell me where the Nnwdaf_MLModelTrainingInfo_Response service operation is described.
questions.reference_answer: Nnwdaf_MLModelTrainingInfo_Response is described in TS 23.288, clause 6.2C.2.2 (General procedure for Federated Learning among Multiple NWDAF instances), where the FL Client NWDAF includes it in the Nnwdaf_MLModelTrainingInfo_Request response to report interim local ML Model information, and optionally the global ML Model metric value, back to the FL Server NWDAF.

questions.question: Which specifications describe Npcf_AMPolicyControl_Update, and which NF calls it when access and mobility policy must change?
questions.reference_answer: Npcf_AMPolicyControl_Update is described in TS 29.507 clause 4.2.1, TS 23.502 clauses 5.2.5.2.1 and 5.2.5.2.5, TS 23.316 clause 8.4.3.2, and TS 23.700-41 clause 6.38.4. It is called by the NF service consumer, e.g. the AMF, to update an AM Policy Association and receive updated access and mobility related policy information when a Policy Control Request Trigger is met or the AMF is relocated due to UE mobility and the old PCF is selected.

questions.question: In which clause is the Naf_ProSe_DiscoveryAuthorizationUpdateNotify service operation defined?
questions.reference_answer: Naf_ProSe_DiscoveryAuthorizationUpdateNotify is defined in TS 23.304, clause 7.2.2.3.

questions.question: Where is the NFType enumeration defined, and which network functions and entities of the 5GC does it list?
questions.reference_answer: The NFType enumeration is defined in TS 29.510, clause 6.1.6.3.3. It lists the network functions and entities: NRF, UDM, AMF, SMF, AUSF, NEF, PCF, SMSF, NSSF, UDR, LMF, GMLC, 5G-EIR, SEPP, UPF, N3IWF, AF, UDSF, BSF, CHF, NWDAF, P-CSCF, CBCF, UCMF, HSS, SOR-AF, SP-AF, MME, SCS/AS, SCEF, SCP, NSSAAF, I-CSCF, S-CSCF, DRA, IMS-AS, AAnF, 5G DDNMF, NSACF, MFAF, EASDF, DCCF, MB-SMF, TSCTSF, ADRF, GBA BSF, CEF, MB-UPF, NSWOF, PKMF, MNPF, SMS-GMSC, SMS-IWMSC, MBSF, MBSTF, PANF, IP-SM-GW, SMS Router, DCSF, MRF, MRFP, MF, SLPKMF, and Roaming Hub (RH).

questions.question: The FlowDirection enumeration tells a PCC filter which way traffic runs — in which clause is it specified and what does the UNSPECIFIED value mean?
questions.reference_answer: The FlowDirection enumeration is specified in TS 29.512, clause 5.6.3.3. The UNSPECIFIED value means the corresponding filter applies for traffic to the UE (downlink), but has no specific direction declared; the service data flow detection shall apply the filter for uplink traffic as if the filter was bidirectional, the PCF shall not use UNSPECIFIED in filters created by the network in NW-initiated procedures, and shall only include UNSPECIFIED in filters in UE-initiated procedures if that same value is received from the NF service consumer.

questions.question: Tell me where the RequestIndication enumeration is defined and which PDU session request types it enumerates.
questions.reference_answer: The RequestIndication enumeration is defined in TS 29.502, clause 6.1.6.3.6. It enumerates the PDU session request types: UE_REQ_PDU_SES_MOD, UE_REQ_PDU_SES_REL, PDU_SES_MOB, NW_REQ_PDU_SES_AUTH, NW_REQ_PDU_SES_MOD, NW_REQ_PDU_SES_REL, EBI_ASSIGNMENT_REQ, and REL_DUE_TO_5G_AN_REQUEST.

questions.question: For LCS client categorisation, where is the LcsClientClass enumeration specified and which client classes does it allow?
questions.reference_answer: The LcsClientClass enumeration is specified in TS 29.503, clause 6.1.6.3.10. It allows the client classes: BROADCAST_SERVICE, OM_IN_HPLMN, OM_IN_VPLMN, ANONYMOUS_LOCATION_SERVICE, SPECIFIC_SERVICE, NWDAF_IN_HPLMN, and NWDAF_IN_VPLMN.

questions.question: In which clause is the N2InformationClass enumeration defined, and what classes of N2 information can it identify?
questions.reference_answer: The N2InformationClass enumeration is defined in TS 29.518, clause 6.1.6.3.4. It identifies the N2 information classes: SM, NRPPa, PWS, PWS-BCAL, PWS-RF, RAN, V2X, PROSE, TSS, RANGING_SL, and A2X.

questions.question: Point me to the clause that defines the CAPIFEvent enumeration and the API-invoker lifecycle events it covers.
questions.reference_answer: The CAPIFEvent enumeration is defined in TS 29.222, clause 8.3.4.3.3. The API-invoker lifecycle events it covers are SERVICE_API_AVAILABLE, SERVICE_API_UNAVAILABLE, SERVICE_API_UPDATE, API_INVOKER_ONBOARDED, API_INVOKER_OFFBOARDED, SERVICE_API_INVOCATION_SUCCESS, SERVICE_API_INVOCATION_FAILURE, ACCESS_CONTROL_POLICY_UPDATE, ACCESS_CONTROL_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE, API_INVOKER_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED, API_INVOKER_UPDATED, API_TOPOLOGY_HIDING_CREATED, and API_TOPOLOGY_HIDING_REVOKED.

questions.question: Where is the N4MessageType enumeration specified, and which PFCP message types does it enumerate?
questions.reference_answer: The N4MessageType enumeration is specified in TS 29.502, clause 6.1.6.3.17. It enumerates the PFCP message types: PFCP_SES_EST_REQ, PFCP_SES_EST_RSP, PFCP_SES_MOD_REQ, PFCP_SES_MOD_RSP, PFCP_SES_DEL_REQ, PFCP_SES_DEL_RSP, PFCP_SES_REP_REQ, and PFCP_SES_REP_RSP.

questions.question: Which specification defines the ProseDirectAllowed enumeration and the announce/monitor permissions it encodes?
questions.reference_answer: The ProseDirectAllowed enumeration is defined in TS 29.503, clause 6.1.6.3.19. Its announce/monitor permission values are ANNOUNCE and MONITOR (open 5G Direct Discovery Model A), and RESTRICTD_ANNOUNCE and RESTRICTD_MONITOR (restricted 5G ProSe Direct Discovery Model A).

questions.question: Tell me where the PpDataType enumeration is defined and which parameter-provisioning data types it lists.
questions.reference_answer: The PpDataType enumeration is defined in TS 29.505, clause 5.4.3.10. It lists the parameter-provisioning data types: COMMUNICATION_CHARACTERISTICS, EXPECTED_UE_BEHAVIOUR, EC_RESTRICTION, ACS_INFO, TRACE, STN_SR, LCS_PRIVACY, SOR_INFO, and RANGINGSL_PRIVACY.

questions.question: For multi-access PDU sessions, where is the AtsssCapability enumeration specified?
questions.reference_answer: The AtsssCapability enumeration is specified in TS 29.512, clause 5.6.3.26.

questions.question: In which clause is the QoeMetric enumeration defined, and which streaming quality metrics does it name?
questions.reference_answer: The QoeMetric enumeration is defined in TS 29.486, clause 6.2.6.3.5. The streaming quality metrics it names are: corruption duration, rebuffering duration, initial buffering duration, successive loss of RTP packets, frame rate deviation, jitter duration, content access/switch time, network resource, average codec bitrate, codec information, Loss of Objects, and distribution of symbol count underrun for Failed Blocks.

questions.question: Where is the MonPerfMetric enumeration specified, and which per-slice performance metrics can it identify?
questions.reference_answer: The MonPerfMetric enumeration is specified in TS 29.435, clause 6.6.6.3.3. The per-slice performance metrics it can identify are: RTT, E2E_LATENCY, PACKET_LOSS, RETRANSMISSIONS, THROUGHPUT, NUM_OF_REG_UES, NUM_OF_EST_PDU_SESS, RESOURCE_USAGE, LOAD_LEVEL, and OTHER (a custom metric).

questions.question: Point me to the clause that defines the DataDomain enumeration used for data-collection records.
questions.reference_answer: The DataDomain enumeration is defined in TS 26.532, clause 7.3.3.1.

questions.question: Which specification defines the ServiceName enumeration listing the SBI service names registered with the NRF?
questions.reference_answer: The ServiceName enumeration is defined in TS 29.510, clause 6.1.6.3.11.

questions.question: Where is the COMMANDCODE enumeration of Diameter command codes defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Diameter command codes allocated for 3GPP (command code table) are defined in TS 29.230, clause 5.1.

questions.question: Tell me where the LocalityType enumeration is defined in the NRF service specification.
questions.reference_answer: The LocalityType enumeration is defined in TS 29.510, clause 6.1.6.3.18 (the NRF service specification).

questions.question: In which clause is the ExpectedUeBehaviourDataset enumeration specified?
questions.reference_answer: The ExpectedUeBehaviourDataset enumeration is specified in TS 29.503, clause 6.1.6.3.29.

questions.question: Where is the DeliveryResult enumeration of the NIDD service defined, and which delivery outcomes does it list?
questions.reference_answer: The DeliveryResult enumeration is defined in TS 29.122, clause 5.7.2.2.3. It lists the delivery outcomes: SUCCESS, UNKNOWN, FAILURE, TRIGGERED, EXPIRED, UNCONFIRMED, REPLACED, and TERMINATE.

questions.question: Point me to the clause that defines the ContextDataSetName enumeration in the UDM data model.
questions.reference_answer: The ContextDataSetName enumeration is defined in TS 29.505, clause 5.4.3.6.

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that describe the Ndccf_DataManagement_Subscribe and Ndccf_DataManagement_Notify service operations, and say which NF consumes them.
questions.reference_answer: Ndccf_DataManagement_Subscribe and Ndccf_DataManagement_Notify are described in TS 29.552 clause 5.13.1, TS 29.574 clause 4.2.2.1, TS 23.700-81 clause 6.44.2, and TS 23.288 clause 6.2.6.3.7. Ndccf_DataManagement_Subscribe is invoked by an NF service consumer (e.g. NWDAF, PCF, NSSF, AMF, SMF, NEF, AF, LMF, ADRF) to subscribe to event notifications from the DCCF, while Ndccf_DataManagement_Notify is used by the DCCF to report detected events to that NF service consumer.

questions.question: Which specification defines the SessionRuleFailureCode enumeration used when a session rule cannot be installed?
questions.reference_answer: The SessionRuleFailureCode enumeration is defined in TS 29.512, clause 5.6.3.17.

questions.question: Where is the PolicyDecisionFailureCode enumeration specified?
questions.reference_answer: The PolicyDecisionFailureCode enumeration is specified in TS 29.512, clause 5.6.3.28.

questions.question: Tell me where the HoState enumeration used in SMF PDU session management is defined.
questions.reference_answer: The HoState enumeration is defined in TS 29.502, clause 6.1.6.3.4.

questions.question: In which clause is the RequestedRuleDataType enumeration defined?
questions.reference_answer: The RequestedRuleDataType enumeration is defined in TS 29.512, clause 5.6.3.7.

questions.question: Where is the CpFailureCode enumeration of the CP parameter provisioning API specified?
questions.reference_answer: The CpFailureCode enumeration is specified in TS 29.122, clause 5.10.2.3.5 (the CP parameter provisioning API).

questions.question: The Client Type IE tells the network which category of LCS client originated a location request — in which clauses is it defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Client Type IE is defined in TS 25.413 clause 9.2.1.46d, TS 25.453 clause 9.2.2.54, and TS 29.171 clause 7.4.5.

questions.question: Where is the Subframe Assignment IE used to signal the TDD configuration defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Subframe Assignment IE is defined in TS 36.455, clause 9.2.25 (TDD Configuration), TS 38.423 clause 9.2.2.38 (NE-DC TDM Pattern), and TS 38.455 clause 9.2.18 (TDD Configuration EUTRA).

questions.question: Tell me where the API provider name information element of the CAPIF registration request is described.
questions.reference_answer: The API provider name information element of the CAPIF registration request is described in TS 23.222, clause 8.28.2.1, and referenced in TS 23.700-95, clause 6.6.1.

questions.question: In which clauses is the 3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority custom HTTP header defined?
questions.reference_answer: The 3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority custom HTTP header is defined in TS 29.500, clause 5.2.3.2.1 (which references clause 5.2.3.2.2 for its full definition).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the SRS Configuration information element.
questions.reference_answer: The SRS Configuration information element is defined in TS 36.455 clause 9.2.11 (UL Configuration), TS 36.459 clause 9.2.4 (UL RTOA Measurement Configuration), and TS 38.423 clause 9.1.1.18 (PARTIAL UE CONTEXT TRANSFER ACKNOWLEDGE, which references TS 38.455).

questions.question: Which documents specify the Nnwdaf_RoamingAnalytics_Subscribe service operation, and which NF invokes it?
questions.reference_answer: Nnwdaf_RoamingAnalytics_Subscribe is specified in TS 33.501 clause X.8.2.1, TS 33.738 clause 6.21.2, TS 29.520 clause 4.9.2.1, and TS 23.288 clause 7.7.2. It is invoked by an NF service consumer, specifically a roaming entry NWDAF (RE-NWDAF, e.g. NWDAFc or NWDAF 1 in the roaming scenario), to subscribe to NWDAF analytics related to roaming UE(s).

questions.question: Which documents specify the GANSS Signal ID information element?
questions.reference_answer: The GANSS Signal ID information element is specified in TS 25.331, clause 10.3.7.88b, TS 25.423, clause 9.2.1.121, and TS 25.433, clause 9.2.1.106.

questions.question: The Access Correlation ID appears in several IMS charging records — in which clauses of TS 32.260 is it described?
questions.reference_answer: The Access Correlation ID field is described in TS 32.260 clauses 6.1.3.3 (S-CSCF CDR content), 6.1.3.4 (P-CSCF CDR content), 6.1.3.6 (MRFC CDR content), 6.1.3.9 (SIP AS CDR content), 6.1.3.11 (E-CSCF CDR content), and 6.1.3.13 (ATCF CDR content).

questions.question: Where is the Consumer ID information element of the ADAE analytics information flows defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Consumer ID information element of the ADAE analytics information flows is defined in TS 23.436, clauses 8.2.4.2, 8.3.3.2, 8.6.3.2, 8.6.3.6, and 8.7.4.2 and 8.7.4.7.

questions.question: Tell me where the Application server identifier information element of the PIN service flows is described.
questions.reference_answer: The Application server identifier information element of the PIN service flows is described in TS 23.542, clauses 8.7.3.2 (PIN service switch request), 8.7.3.4 (PIN configuration service switch configure request), 8.9.3.2 (PIN Management PEGC Service Continuity request), and 8.9.3.4 (PIN Management PEGC Configuration request).

questions.question: In which clauses is the Delegated-IPv6-Prefix RADIUS attribute defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Delegated-IPv6-Prefix RADIUS attribute is defined in TS 29.061, clause 16.4.1 (Access-Request message, sent from GGSN/P-GW to AAA server), as attribute number 123, an IPv6 prefix delegated to the user.

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the APN Selection Mode field of the packet-switched charging records.
questions.reference_answer: The APN Selection Mode field is defined in TS 32.251, clauses 6.1.1 (SGSN S-CDR), 6.1.2 (S-GW SGW-CDR), 6.1.3 (P-GW PGW-CDR), 6.1.13 (ePDG-CDR), 6.1.14 (TDF-CDR), and 6.1.15 (TWAG-CDR).

questions.question: For MSGin5G message delivery, where is the Delivery Status information element defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Delivery Status information element for MSGin5G message delivery is defined in TS 23.554, clauses 8.3.4 (Message delivery status report to the MSGin5G Server) and 8.3.5 (Message delivery status report from the MSGin5G Server), where it gives the delivery status description, including success or failure in delivery.

questions.question: Which documents specify the M-NG-RAN node to S-NG-RAN node Container information element on XnAP?
questions.reference_answer: The M-NG-RAN node to S-NG-RAN node Container information element is defined in TS 38.423 (XnAP), appearing in clauses 9.1.2.1 (S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST), 9.1.2.5 (S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST), 9.1.2.9 (S-NODE MODIFICATION CONFIRM), 9.1.2.10 (S-NODE MODIFICATION REFUSE), 9.1.2.12 (S-NODE CHANGE CONFIRM), and 9.1.2.14 (S-NODE RELEASE REQUEST).

questions.question: Where is the MR-DC Resource Coordination Information information element specified?
questions.reference_answer: The MR-DC Resource Coordination Information information element is specified in TS 38.423, clause 9.2.2.33, and appears in XnAP messages such as S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE (clause 9.1.2.2) and S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE (clause 9.1.2.6).

questions.question: Tell me where the MeNB to SgNB Container information element used in EN-DC is defined.
questions.reference_answer: The MeNB to SgNB Container information element used in EN-DC is defined in TS 36.423 (X2AP), appearing in clauses 9.1.4.1 (SGNB ADDITION REQUEST), 9.1.4.5 (SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST), 9.1.4.9 (SGNB MODIFICATION CONFIRM), and 9.1.4.18 (SGNB CHANGE CONFIRM).

questions.question: In which clauses is the Collection timestamp parameter of the media-streaming event exposure defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Collection timestamp parameter is defined in TS 26.501, clauses 4.7.4.3 (Common baseline parameters for event exposure), 4.7.4.4 (QoE metrics UE data), 4.7.4.5 (consumption reporting UE data), 4.7.4.6 (dynamic policy invocation UE data), 4.7.4.7 (Network Assistance UE data), and 4.7.4.8 (media streaming access activity UE data).

questions.question: Where is the Page type information element that tells the BSS whether paging is for a call, an MT SMS or SS activity specified?
questions.reference_answer: The Page type information element is specified in TS 23.018, clauses 8.1.17 (Page MS) and 8.1.32 (Search For MS). It indicates whether the paging is for a circuit-switched call, MT SMS delivery, SS activity, or Active Location Retrieval.

questions.question: Which specifications define the Old NG-RAN node UE XnAP ID reference information element?
questions.reference_answer: The Old NG-RAN node UE XnAP ID reference information element is defined in TS 38.423, appearing in clauses 9.1.1.9 (RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT RESPONSE), 9.1.1.11 (XN-U ADDRESS INDICATION), 9.1.1.16 (RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT CONFIRM), and 9.1.1.19 (PARTIAL UE CONTEXT TRANSFER FAILURE).

questions.question: For CAMEL charging in the MSC, where is the Free format Data field described?
questions.reference_answer: For CAMEL charging in the MSC, the Free format Data field is described in TS 32.250, clauses 6.1.3.1 (Mobile originated call attempt), 6.1.3.3 (Mobile originated call forwarding attempt), 6.1.3.18 (Terminating CAMEL call attempt), 6.1.3.23 (Mobile originated call attempt, CAMEL CPH adapted version), 6.1.3.26 (Mobile originated call forwarding attempt, CAMEL CPH adapted version), and 6.1.3.27 (Terminating CAMEL call attempt, CAMEL CPH adapted version).

questions.question: Where is the Call Duration field of the circuit-switched charging records defined?
questions.reference_answer: The Call Duration field of the circuit-switched charging records is defined in TS 32.250, clauses 6.1.3.17 (Common equipment usage record), 6.1.3.23 (Mobile originated call attempt, CAMEL CPH adapted version), 6.1.3.24 (gsmSCF initiated CAMEL CPH call attempt), and 6.1.3.25 (New Call Segment in a MO, CF and MT CAMEL Dialogue).

questions.question: The EAS Endpoint information element carries the URI or address used to reach an edge application server — in which clauses is it defined?
questions.reference_answer: The EAS Endpoint information element is defined in TS 23.558, clauses 8.2.4 (EAS Profile) and 8.2.8 (EEC Context), referenced also in TS 23.700-98 clause 7.37.2 and TS 23.958 clause 5.3.1. It contains endpoint information (e.g. URI, FQDN, IP address) used to communicate with the EAS, which the EEC can discover and expose to ACs so they can establish contact with the EAS.

questions.question: Where is the LCLS-BSS-Status information element defined in the local call local switch specification?
questions.reference_answer: The LCLS-BSS-Status information element is defined in TS 23.284, clauses 16.3.2 (Assignment Procedure), 16.3.4 (Handover Complete Procedure), 16.3.5 (Handover Performed Procedure), and 16.3.8 (LCLS Notification Procedure) between the MSC-Server and the BSS.

questions.question: Tell me where the Talker priority information element of the voice group call service is described.
questions.reference_answer: The Talker priority information element of the voice group call service is described in TS 43.068, clauses 12.2.4 (Send Group Call End Signal), 12.2.6 (Process Group Call Signalling), 12.2.9 (Send Group Call Info), and 12.3.2 (GCR Interrogation ack).

questions.question: In which clauses is the SEALDD flow ID information element defined?
questions.reference_answer: The SEALDD flow ID information element is defined in TS 23.433, clauses 9.2.3.3 (SEALDD regular transmission connection establishment request), 9.3.3.3 (SEALDD URLLC transmission connection establishment request), 9.3.3.5 (SEALDD URLLC transmission connection update request), and 9.9.3.1 (Transmission quality management request).

questions.question: Point me to the clauses that define the Requester PINE ID information element of the personal IoT network flows.
questions.reference_answer: The Requester PINE ID information element of the personal IoT network flows is defined in TS 23.542, clauses 8.5.10.3.2 (PIN configuration request), 8.5.11.3.3 (PIN services registration response), 8.5.11.3.4 (PIN services de-registration request), and 8.7.3.8 (PIN Service Discovery Request).
